text:
jonathan: deploy-bot just blocked the EU canary promotion for payments-api 
jonathan: reason: CRD ownership conflict from optional-dep-operator (postinstall hook failing) :thinking_face:

deploy-bot: [deploy] canary promotion halted at 60%
deploy-bot: hook post-install failed: exit code 1
deploy-bot: logs:
```
Error: cannot create CustomResourceDefinition "paymentsconfigs.example.com": resource version conflict: owned by chart optional-dep-operator v2.1.0
```

maria: ugh, that operator was bumped in the subchart in this release. looks like it owns the CRD now, which blocks reapply during canary pods recreate

jonathan: we have two choices: pin payments-api helm chart to previous subchart (v2.0.x) so canary continues, or pause promotion and follow up with hotpatch to operator to adopt-previous-owner script
maria: pin sounds safest for immediate unblock. we can assemble release-note blurb for the pin and schedule operator migration in next weekly window

ashok: pinning is fast but note: there was a behaviour change in optional-dep-operator v2.1.0 that fixes a race on kv init. if we pin we must call it out for tech debt
liz: +1 pin for rollback surface. what's the exact helm override?
maria: run: `helm promote --chart payments-api --version 1.12.3 --set subcharts.optionalDep.version=2.0.9`

jonathan: can someone run a dry-run to confirm no other hooks will error? also want to verify the deploy-bot will resume promotion automatically once new release is observed
maria: doing a dry-run now in preprod
maria: dry-run output shows postinstall hook skipped because CRD exists and ownerRef matches 2.0.9 — good

deploy-bot: promotion paused -> waiting for new release with pinned subchart

jonathan: OK. decision: pin subchart to 2.0.9 and push a post-release ticket to migrate operator ownership next week. maria, can you draft the release notes: short explainer + impact + migration playbook?
maria: will do. draft pinned note: "payments-api release pinned subchart optional-dep-operator to 2.0.9 due to CRD ownership conflict observed during EU canary promotion. No runtime behaviour impact expected; operator migration scheduled for next maintenance window. Action required: none for customers."

ashok: created GH issue infra/ops#452: operator ownership migration plan + checklist (assigning to platform)
liz: I'll watch the canary when you promote. set @liz as reviewer in the promotion PR

jonathan: timeline: pin + promote now, monitor 30m, if green -> promote global. if any further hook fails -> rollback to previous chart revision and open incident.
maria: performing pin and promote now -> `helm upgrade --install payments-api ./charts/payments-api -f values-eu.yaml --version 1.12.3 --set subcharts.optionalDep.version=2.0.9 --wait`
maria: promoted to EU canary, 5 pods ready, 3/3 healthchecks passing :thumbsup:

liz: observing logs, no hook errors. latency at 99p looks stable
deploy-bot: EU canary promotion succeeded; auto-promote to global scheduled in 25m unless manual hold requested

jonathan: thanks team. maria please attach the release-note blurb to the promotion PR and to the deploy ticket. we'll track infra/ops#452 for the follow-up migration. :white_check_mark:
